key_insight: A cooperative quoter–risk-manager split achieved the best reported market-making result only with careful reward shaping; decomposition alone performed poorly.
engineering_relevance: The work provides a data-reconstruction and training pipeline for studying liquidity provision in thin prediction-market order books.
method: Reconstruct order-level LOBSTER-format data from Polymarket L2 feeds.
Redesign single-agent observations, quoting actions and inventory controls.
Train cooperative quoter and risk-manager RNN policies with recurrent IPPO, testing reward blending and post-fill markout.
evidence_signal: Training used data from 417 real markets, with held-out evaluation based on realised end-of-episode portfolio value; no configuration established positive average value in periodic evaluation.
watch_item: Each configuration used one training seed, and jointly changed observations, actions and risk constraints prevent isolating their individual contributions.
paper_title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making on Prediction-Market Order Books
